ETC encoder (lead, 2026-09-30): libtex3ds.encode ETC1/ETC1A4 = etcpak first pass, then every block with a visible pixel is searched again (both flips, individual 4:4:4 and differential 5:5:5 modes, all 8 tables, base colours within 2/3 steps of the alpha-weighted mean), error weighted by the stored 4-bit alpha squared (floor 0.01); per block the lower weighted error wins, so it is never worse than etcpak. Packed words decode bit-exactly with texture2ddecoder (selftest). Re-encoding the Japanese originals: 24-28 dB (etcpak) -> 33-70 dB. At most LIBTEX3DS_ETC_MAX=2048 blocks refined per texture (every text texture has <= 1,024); LIBTEX3DS_ETC=fast = old behaviour. Cost 1-3 s per text texture; build_lyt --selftest 160 s.
